description: This script manages self-healing and diagnostic actions for a device, including reboot logic, process restarts, network diagnostics, and maintenance window checks. It handles different device types and configurations, and interacts with system utilities and configuration databases.

methods.name: getstat
methods.description: Reads CPU statistics from /proc/stat and formats the output.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts a specific field from a string based on delimiter 'x'.

methods.name: change
methods.description: Calculates the difference in CPU statistics between two snapshots.

methods.name: getVendorName
methods.description: Retrieves the device vendor name via dmcli or syscfg, depending on device type.

methods.name: getModelName
methods.description: Retrieves the device model name via dmcli or syscfg.

methods.name: getDateTime
methods.description: Returns current date/time with nanoseconds in 'YYYY-MM-DD:HH:MM:SS:6N' format.

methods.name: getCMMac
methods.description: Retrieves the Cable Modem MAC address via dmcli or system commands.

methods.name: restart_adv_security
methods.description: Restarts the advanced security process based on device type and configuration.

methods.name: checkConditionsbeforeAction
methods.description: Checks network registration and active traffic before performing corrective actions.

methods.name: resetRouter
methods.description: Performs system diagnostics and reboots the device if conditions are met.

methods.name: rebootNeeded
methods.description: Determines if a reboot is necessary based on system state, counts, and conditions.

methods.name: checkCaptivePortal
methods.description: Checks if captive portal needs to be enabled based on network and device flags.

methods.name: resetNeeded
methods.description: Performs process restart or system reboot based on various conditions and configurations.

methods.name: storeInformation
methods.description: Collects system info such as memory, CPU load, connected devices, and MoCA stats.

methods.name: setRebootreason
methods.description: Sets reboot reason and counter in system configuration.

methods.name: CheckAndProceedFurtherBasedonDiagnosticMode
methods.description: Checks if device is in diagnostic mode to prevent reboot during that state.

methods.name: checkMaintenanceWindow
methods.description: Checks if current time is within the device's maintenance window for reboot scheduling.
